en: <Color:255,200,200,255>Hmm. Okay then.<Color:Default>
I try not to overthink it. I don't like the idea of pigeonholin' people. Yer you, and that's that.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hehe, that answer is so fitting of you.<Color:Default>
I don't understand the question.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Like... Do you like me?<Color:Default>
How about you? Whaddya think of me?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I... Well, of course I like you.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>But if you're dodging the question like that, you probably don't like me.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Even if I like someone, I don't ever feel like devoting myself to them.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>So even if I do wind up really liking someone, I have to assume they won't like me back.<Color:Default>
Yer an odd duck.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I am well aware of that fact.<Color:Default>
But that don't mean ya gotta do whatever the other person wants. I like a woman who sticks to her guns.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I'm relieved to hear that!<Color:Default>
Ya don't gotta do nothing. Guys feel good just knowin' they've got a woman at home waitin' for 'em.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Really?<Color:Default>
Yeah. Havin' someone waitin' for you to come home every day gives ya strength to fight on.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hmm. I am pretty good at waiting around!<Color:Default>
Tell ya what. If ya promise to wait for me, I promise I'll come back to you.
<Color:255,200,200,255>All right!<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>But you still haven't actually answered my original question, Saejima-san.<Color:Default>
Oh, I haven't?
<Color:255,200,200,255>So what is it?<Color:Default>
I like ya. I especially like how yer a sharper cookie than ya let on.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Wait, what's that supposed to mean?<Color:Default>
Ya asked your question, that's my answer.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hey, no fair! You're not leaving until I get an answer out of you!<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>That's all you have to say, after all that?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>But that is so you, Saejima-san.<Color:Default>
Hello there.
Well? Isn't she hot? Kaguya-chan here is 26 years old, a Scorpio, and her blood type is A. She has a younger sister, and she watches martial arts!
So, I came here to enjoy a sweet evening with Kaguya-chan.
Saejima-san, welcome! Thank you for requesting me!
You came to see me? Oh, let me guess. Am I growing on you?
Saejima-san, I've been waiting for you! I'm looking forward to today!
Nice to meet you. I'm Kaguya.
Here, this is my business card.

Wearing the usual, I see.
Your fashion sense is very, uh, original.
Whoa, what's the deal with that outfit? If you didn't have anything to wear, maybe it would be better for you to stay at home, you know?

en: Can I have another drink?
I'm kinda hungry.
What would you like?
Oh hey, you like that too? <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
You actually like that? I guess our tastes are pretty different.
Okay, maybe some other time.
Hey, want to play the chocolate stick game?
Here, let me feed it to you. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Say what now!?
Over here, please!
I'll fix your drink.
Here you are!
You're quite a big drinker!
Let me refill your glass for you.
Thank you for coming! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
I gotta get goin'.
Why don't you go and kill time somewhere? I'll be in touch with you later.
All right, I'll get you your check.
Check, please!
Oh, you're leaving already?
(Oops, I don't got the cash on me.)
No, I gotta get goin'.
(Guess I've run outta stuff to talk about. I oughta be on my way.)
Wanna go on a date after this?
I already told you, no. Geez, you're a nag.
Ask all you want, but the answer's still no!
Guess ya really mean it.
After my shift, you mean?
Sorry, Saejima-san, I already have plans today. But please ask me again sometime.
No problem. I understand.
Yeah, I don't know. I'm not really in the mood today.
Okay. Maybe next time.
I'm sorry, but I feel like we should get to know each other better first.
Hmm. Okay, but just for a little bit.
Heh. Glad I asked.
You want to go out with me that badly? Okay, just for a little bit.
Sure, I've been wanting to spend more time with you too, Saejima-san.
Of course I do! I'd never say no to you, Saejima-san!
Yeah, okay. Sometimes it's nice to get out and walk around a bit.
I love it! You know me so well, Saejima-san!
Wow, really!? I've been wanting one of these! Thank you!
Are you sure? I'll take good care of it!
Oh, thanks.
What the heck is this? I'm not sure what I'd even need this for.
Huh? This again?
I don't really need more than one of these.
Maybe you'd like to come see me again, Saejima-san?
Sure, I'll ask for ya next time I come in.
You really mean it!? I'll be waiting!
Thanks for coming today! See you later!
Yeah, see ya.
Hehe! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
I had so much fun today!
See you later! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
You bet.
I wonder what you'll get!
Fingers crossed...
You won <Color:8>Toughness Infinity<Color:Default>!
Oh, one of those. We see them a lot.
That's no good. Maybe I oughta try again.
You won <Color:8>French Cologne<Color:Default>!
You won <Color:8>Staminan Spark<Color:Default>!
Oh, that one's not so bad.
There's all kindsa things in here, huh?
You won <Color:8>Goddess of Children Amulet<Color:Default>!
You won <Color:8>Monogrammed Bag<Color:Default>!
Oh wow, that's pretty rare!
Heh, that's great.
You won <Color:8>Italian Women's Watch<Color:Default>!
You won <Color:8>Mystery Stone<Color:Default>!
You won <Color:8>Swiss Watch<Color:Default>!
Whoa! You hit the jackpot! Way to go, Saejima-san! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Heh, guess it was worth it.
You won <Color:8>Platinum Membership Card<Color:Default>!
Chocolate stick game time!
Champagne time!
Champagne tower, please!
The snow festival sure is somethin', ain't it? I had no idea this many tourists came to see it.
It's quite impressive, yes! I'm impressed by the people who make those things, and those who come out to look at them in this freezing cold.
I hear that. I carve wooden dolls myself, but carvin' ice like that looks like no easy task.
Really? I don't know much about that sort of thing. You're much more knowledgeable than me!
The cold gives it more meanin'. Folks put up with the cold to see a piece a' art that disappears when it gets warmer.
Wow, you really like this sort of thing, don't you? I wouldn't have ever guessed!
Have ya ever made anything yerself?
Never. I mean, I've built snowmen when I was little, but...
Yeah, ya don't strike me as a kid who'd go outside to play.
That has nothing to do with it. Sure, people from Tokyo get excited when it snows because it doesn't happen often there.
But for people from Hokkaido, it's not really a fun time for us when it snows. It's a huge pain to have to go shovel it all the time.
I get ya. I hear sometimes the snow piles up as high as a two-story house. I suppose that ain't somethin' to be happy about.
Yes. It would be nicer to visit as a tourist.
Ya gotta have a sense of fun. If ya don't look forward to somethin' like the festival, winter would suck every year.
But it does suck! We're not talking about nice, fluttery snow, either! We're talking blizzards here!
Yer exaggeratin'. It ain't like you're up in the mountains.
Don't underestimate the snow in Hokkaido! It gets pretty intense. If you lived here, you'd understand real quick.
So whaddya do when it snows? Stay inside curled up on yer futon?
No, the heating in my house is turned up so high it's actually hot inside!
Really now? When I think of Hokkaido, I think of folks bein' bundled up in warm clothes.
Not at all! I'm fine wearing a T-shirt. I don't even wear any clothes at home.
I... Wow.
Ya oughta save electricity. It's wasteful.
What? But if I don't keep the heater on, I'm gonna freeze!
Then just turn it down a degree or two. Energy conservation is important.
But it's not like I'm being wasteful. We honestly wouldn't be able to live here without the heat being that high.
Guess I should start callin' ya sweetie-pie, since ya practically live in an oven.
That's a good one! If I had your sense of humor, winter would be much more bearable.
Heh. Maybe.
Hokkaido sure is big. There's so much to see outside of Tsukimino. I don't think I'll be able to see it all.
I know. Even I haven't been to that many places.
I mean, I go to Otaru once in a while. Oh, and I went to Hakodate once on a school field trip.
That's all? I suppose folks from here would rather go to Tokyo or Okinawa or somethin'.
Yeah, we don't vacation within Hokkaido much.
Ya oughta get out more. You should know 'bout the place yer from.
But it's so big I don't think of the whole place as my home. Even in Tokyo, anything outside the 23 wards might as well be another prefecture.
I guess so. I dunno western Tokyo all that well.
How about Abashiri?
Abashiri? Where that prison is?
Yeah. Ever been there?
I haven't, no. Is there anything there other than the prison?
Lemme think... They've got Nipopo dolls.
Oh? What are those?
Nipopo dolls. They're a local Abashiri craft.
Wow, really? I didn't know about those. You sure know a lot about Abashiri, Saejima-san!
Anyway, there's really no reason to go to another city if you're in Sapporo. And outside of Tsukimino, there's not much else in the rest of Sapporo either.
I see. Guess Tsukimino's the only place to go for fun. Where do folks in the suburbs go to drink?
Oh, we have plenty of customers who take the train to come all the way here to Tsukimino!
Interestin'. It's almost like a mini-vacation.
Yeah, all they have are regular bars out there, so if they want the company of a girl while they're drinking, they have no choice but to come here.
Hm. So Tsukimino is like a hub for the people of Hokkaido.
Yer kiddin'. There's gotta be places to drink without comin' all the way to Tsukimino.
There really aren't though.
There was a medical conference in Sapporo a while back. Hundreds of doctors came from across the country, and they all came to Tsukimino.
Yep. All the clubs were packed. The streets were overflowing with people who couldn't get in anywhere.
Wow. Guess there really isn't anywhere else to drink...
That means there's plenty of nature. Not only is there no greenery in Tokyo, there's so many buildings that sometimes ya can't even see the sky.
That's just another way of saying there's nothing here.
Well, what's wrong with that? Livin' in Kamurocho, ya'd think the air was nothin' but car exhaust. The air in Tsukimino's much cleaner.
We're not out in the sticks, you know! Do you think we're in some mountain village?
Ya know, I get the feelin' that the women around here got kinda huge breasts.
What? Really?
For sure. The women I see 'round town tend to have pretty big ones, I tell ya.
I see you're into checking out things like that, Saejima-san!
Am I wrong? Maybe it's just me.
I've never heard anyone say so before. I think it may be wishful thinking.
Maybe I'm imaginin' things. Or maybe the women here just give off that kind of vibe.
I do hear that we have very white skin sometimes. I guess there is a lot of fair-skinned girls around here.
